sources.takeaway: Mid-level egocentric cues (hand manipulation point, head motion via homography, gaze) + motion-compensated dense trajectories beat object-only baselines; attention-point-gated features give +2-16% with 20% image area.
sources.title: Li et al. 2015 — Delving Into Egocentric Actions (CVPR)

sources.takeaway: Explicit RGB+HSV+YCbCr combinational thresholds improve skin-pixel recall over single-space rules; cheap per-pixel if/then logic with no learning.
sources.title: Kolkur et al. 2017 — Human Skin Detection Using RGB, HSV and YCbCr Color Models

sources.takeaway: Standardized benchmark of rule-based (GMM/Bayes/SPL/Cheddad/Chen/SA/DYC) vs deep skin detectors; rule-based wins on cost/simplicity, loses under uncontrolled light/complex backgrounds; DYC and spatial-analysis variants most robust classical choices.
sources.title: Nanni et al. 2023 — A Standardized Approach for Skin Detection (J. Imaging)

sources.takeaway: Canonical taxonomy: explicit threshold rules vs Bayes/GMM vs spatial diffusion; CbCr-only models + luminance-dropping generalise best across illumination; pixel rules need region post-processing.
sources.title: Vezhnevets et al. 2003 — A Survey on Pixel-Based Skin Color Detection Techniques

sources.takeaway: Prune/count/rank with per-class self-confidence thresholds from out-of-sample pred_probs exactly finds label errors under class-conditional noise; needs only (noisy labels + pred_probs), model-agnostic.
sources.title: Northcutt et al. 2021 — Confident Learning: Estimating Uncertainty in Dataset Labels (JAIR)

sources.takeaway: Lecture version of CL: 100k+ ImageNet label issues, 3-step weak-supervision recipe (estimate joint, prune, reweight), no hyperparameters beyond CV folds.
sources.title: MIT DCAI 2024 — Label Errors and Confident Learning (lecture)

sources.takeaway: Datalab unifies label/outlier/duplicate/drift audits from pred_probs + features; report()/get_issues()/get_info() pattern directly reusable for 150-window audit + near-duplicate wearer/clip detection.
sources.title: Cleanlab docs — Datalab quickstart: unified audit for labels/outliers/duplicates

sources.takeaway: Pool-based AL should query highest calibration error first, then uncertainty (lexicographic); kernel calibration-error estimator under covariate shift bounds ECE on pool + test — directly relevant to threshold calibration with few labels.
sources.title: Bui et al. 2025 — Calibrated Uncertainty Sampling for Active Learning

sources.takeaway: With pretrained embeddings, TypiClust diversity first then Margin uncertainty (TCM switch) beats either alone and fixes cold-start; simple heuristic, no complex scheduler needed.
sources.title: Doucet et al. 2024 — Bridging Diversity and Uncertainty in Active Learning (TCM)

sources.takeaway: Difference detectors (to 100k fps CPU) + per-video specialised classifiers + cost-based cascade search give 265-15500x speedups at 1-5% accuracy loss; thresholds (delta_diff, c_low, c_high) set jointly on held-out eval set.
sources.title: Kang et al. 2017 — NoScope: Optimizing Neural Network Queries over Video at Scale

sources.takeaway: On-camera filtering with only cheap CPU frame-differencing features; per-query/per-content feature+threshold selection retrained on drift; filters 51-97% frames at target accuracy, beats FilterForward/NoScope-light on camera.
sources.title: Li et al. 2020 — Reducto: On-Camera Filtering for Resource-Efficient Real-Time Video Analytics

sources.takeaway: Motion-vector-field macroblock classes (no decode beyond MVs) drive shot-change / motion-discontinuity / global-motion-outlier detection at very low cost — template for HEVC compressed-domain pre-filter.
sources.title: Lin et al. 2012 — Macroblock Classification Method for Video Applications Involving Motions

sources.takeaway: Taxonomy of EVA frame-filtering / ROI / compression / early-exit techniques plus edge frameworks and datasets; confirms frame-filtering + split-phase sampling as cheapest wins on weak edge nodes.
sources.title: Xu et al. 2023 — Edge Video Analytics: A Survey (IEEE COMST)
